How much does carpet installation cost in Oak Harbor, WA?

Plan on $4 to $7 per square foot installed, which covers the carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and haul-away. A typical Oak Harbor project lands between $2,400 and $3,900, and a single bedroom usually runs $600–$1,000. Carpet grade swings the total more than anything else — and you choose it at home, with our samples lying on the floor they would cover.
Does the mobile carpet showroom really come out to Oak Harbor?

Yes. The van crosses Deception Pass with 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades aboard. Samples go down in the actual rooms, so the color you choose is the color you will live with; then we measure every room and stair and leave a written price the same visit. The trip is free, and there is no mainland store you need to drive to.
What does carpet stretching cost in Oak Harbor?

Carpet stretching in Oak Harbor starts at $99 per room, and most rooms land between $99 and $180. Power-stretching pulls ripples, buckles and trip spots flat for roughly a fifth of what replacement costs. If the pile still stands and the color still works — say, before a rental inspection or a sale — stretching is usually the right money.
How much does it cost to carpet stairs in an Oak Harbor home?

Stair carpet starts at $18 per step in waterfall or cap-and-band style, and a typical full staircase comes out between $235 and $400. Landings and pie-shaped winders are measured and counted in the written quote up front, so the number you approve is the number you pay.
How long will my carpet installation take?

Most Oak Harbor houses are done in one day — three or four rooms plus a staircase is a normal day for the crew. A full house with heavy furniture can run into a second day. If you are working against movers, a report date or a housing inspection, tell us; the completion date goes on your quote in writing.
Do you move furniture, or do I clear the rooms first?

We move it. Beds, dressers, couches and tables are included on most jobs, and everything goes back where it stood. You handle the small stuff — closet floors, electronics, breakables and anything you would rather carry yourself. If a household-goods pack-out is on the calendar, we can schedule around the boxes.
Should I restretch my carpet or replace it before moving out?

Restretch when the pile stands up, the backing is sound and the color still suits you — that is a $99-per-room fix, and it satisfies most landlord and housing-office walk-throughs. Replace when traffic lanes are matted flat, seams are splitting, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has survived professional cleaning. Send photos or book a measure and we will tell you which you have before we quote.
Which Oak Harbor neighborhoods and nearby areas do you serve?

All of Oak Harbor — Old Town, Scenic Heights, Swantown, Fort Nugent, Crescent Harbor, Maylor Point, Clover Valley, Dugualla Bay, Strawberry Point and West Beach — plus Penn Cove Park, San de Fuca, Coupeville and Cornet Bay, and across the bridge to Anacortes. Elsewhere on Whidbey? Ask when you book; the van covers the island.
What carpet handles dogs and cats best?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing, installed over a moisture-barrier pad. The barrier keeps accidents from soaking into the subfloor — that soak-through is what causes the odor nothing removes — and solution-dyed fiber can take diluted bleach without losing color. The barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot, and both samples ride in the van so you can compare at home.
What warranty covers the installation work?

OC Flooring covers the workmanship with a 1-year warranty, and the carpet carries its mill warranty on wear and stain — usually 10 to 25 years depending on grade. Both go on your quote in writing. Worth knowing: some mill warranties require a minimum pad grade, which is one more reason all three pad grades come along on the measure.
